title: Corruption and the Ark

questions.question: Why did God decide to send the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:5,11: The wickedness of man was great and the earth was filled with violence.

questions.question: Why did Noah find favor with God?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:9: Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation.

questions.question: What did God tell Noah to build?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:14: "Make yourself an ark of gopher wood."

questions.question: How many sons did Noah have?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:10: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

questions.question: Who would enter the ark with Noah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:18-20: Noah, his wife, sons, their wives, and pairs of animals.

questions.question: What type of wood was used to build the ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:14: "Make yourself an ark of gopher wood."

questions.question: How many people were saved on the ark?
questions.explanation: Noah, his wife, their three sons and their three wives = 8 people.

questions.question: What did Genesis 6 say about man's thoughts?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:5: "every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually."

questions.question: How many levels did the ark have?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:16: "Make it with lower, second, and third decks."

questions.question: What was Noah to cover the ark with inside and out?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:14: "cover it inside and out with pitch."

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the ark in cubits?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:15: The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

questions.question: Who are the "sons of God" mentioned in Genesis 6:2?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:2: The identity of the "sons of God" is debated - some say angels, others say Sethites.

questions.question: Who were the Nephilim mentioned in Genesis 6?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:4: "The Nephilim were on the earth... mighty men who were of old."

questions.question: What did God limit human lifespan to in Genesis 6:3?
According to Genesis 6:6, what did God feel about creating humanity?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:6: "the LORD regretted that he had made man... and it grieved him to his heart."

key_verse_text: Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation. Noah walked with God.
